rule: The best-calendar-day removal and worst-calendar-day loss concentration gates apply separately to training and validation at24bps base cost. Removing each half's best net day must leave strictly positive mean net per remaining trade. Worst negative-day absolute net sum must not exceed half the sum of positive-day net sums. No positive-day pool fails the gate. Other cost levels and diagnostic buckets may report the same statistics but do not create alternative survivor gates.
